en.t: Basil II is crowned co-Emperor of the Byzantine Empire
en.s: Basil II Porphyrogenitus (Greek: Βασίλειος Πορφυρογέννητος, romanized: Basíleios Porphyrogénnētos; 958 – 15 December 1025), given the epithet the Bulgar Slayer, was the senior Byzantine emperor from 976 to 1025. He and his brother Constantine VIII were crowned before their father Romanos II died in 963, but they were too young to rule.

zh.t: 巴西尔二世加冕为共治皇帝
zh.s: 960年4月22日，巴西尔二世加冕为拜占庭帝国共治皇帝。他生于958年、逝于1025年，后因与保加利亚作战而获“屠保加利亚者”称号，并于976年至1025年成为帝国的首席皇帝。他与弟弟君士坦丁八世在父亲罗曼努斯二世于963年去世前均已加冕，但当时年纪太小，尚不能亲政。

en.t: Gregory VII was elected pope following the death of Alexander II
en.s: Pope Gregory VII (Latin: Gregorius VII; c. 1015 – 25 May 1085), born Hildebrand of Sovana (Italian: Ildebrando di Soana), was head of the Catholic Church and ruler of the Papal States from 22 April 1073 to his death in 1085. He is venerated as a saint in the Catholic Church.

zh.t: 格列高利七世当选教皇
zh.s: 教皇格列高利七世（拉丁语：Gregorius VII，约1015年—1085年5月25日）原名索瓦纳的希尔德布兰德（意大利语：Ildebrando di Soana），于1073年4月22日起担任天主教会领袖和教皇国统治者，直至1085年去世。他被天主教会尊为圣人。

en.s: The Battle of Lipitsa (Russian: Ли́пицкая би́тва) was the decisive battle in the Vladimir-Suzdal war of succession (1212–1216), the struggle over the grand princely throne of Vladimir following the death of Vsevolod the Big Nest. In the battle, fought on 22 April 1216, the forces of Mstislav the Bold and Konstantin Vsevolodovich defeated those of Konstantin's younger brothers Yuri Vsevolodovich and Yaroslav Vsevolodovich.

zh.s: 利皮察战役（俄语：Ли́пицкая би́тва）是弗拉基米尔—苏兹达尔继承战争（1212—1216年）中的决定性战役。这场战争争夺弗拉基米尔大公之位，起因是“长巢者”弗谢沃洛德去世。1216年4月22日，勇者姆斯季斯拉夫和康斯坦丁·弗谢沃洛多维奇率军击败了康斯坦丁的弟弟尤里·弗谢沃洛多维奇和雅罗斯拉夫·弗谢沃洛多维奇的部队。

en.s: The Battle of Gamenario, fought on 22 April 1345, was a decisive battle of the wars between the Guelphs (represented by the Angevins) and Ghibellines (Lombard communes). It took place in north-west Italy in what is now part of the commune of Santena about 15 km southeast of Turin. In the spring of 1344 queen Joan I of Naples sent royal seneschal Reforce (Reforza or Rinforzato) d'Agoult to northern Italy in hopes of putting an end to the war with the John II, Marquess of Montferrat, who had also obtained the title of governor of the rich commune of Asti (1339) after expelling the Solaro family.

zh.s: 加梅纳里奥战役于1345年4月22日打响，是圭尔夫派（安茹王朝一方）与吉伯林派（伦巴第城邦一方）之间战争中的决定性战役。战场位于意大利西北部，今都灵东南约15公里的圣泰纳市镇境内。1344年春，那不勒斯女王乔万娜一世派王室总管雷福斯·达古尔（亦作雷福尔扎或林福尔扎托）前往意大利北部，希望结束与蒙费拉托侯爵约翰二世之间的战争。约翰二世于1339年驱逐索拉罗家族后，也取得了富庶的阿斯蒂市总督头衔。

en.s: The Battle of Canturino (22 April 1363) was a clash of two condottiere companies, the long-established Great Company under Konrad von Landau and the newer White Company under Albert Sterz and John Hawkwood.

zh.s: 坎图里诺战役发生于1363年4月22日，是两支雇佣兵团之间的交战。一方是康拉德·冯·朗道率领、早已成名的大佣兵团，另一方是由阿尔贝特·施特尔茨和约翰·霍克伍德率领、较新的白佣兵团。

en.s: The Battle of Polog (Albanian: Beteja e Pollogut) was the result of an Albanian incursion into Ottoman territory. Aided by Alfonso the Magnanimous, the Albanian leader Skanderbeg made plans to recapture Svetigrad, which had been lost in 1448. His strategy involved launching an invasion of Macedonia to devastate the country surrounding Svetigrad and to lure the garrison into a trap.

zh.s: 波洛格战役（阿尔巴尼亚语：Beteja e Pollogut）起因于阿尔巴尼亚人入侵奥斯曼领土。在“宽宏者”阿方索的帮助下，阿尔巴尼亚领袖斯坎德培计划夺回1448年失守的斯韦蒂格勒德。他打算入侵马其顿，摧毁斯韦蒂格勒德周边地区，并诱使守军落入陷阱。

en.s: The first landing of European explorers to the territory of present-day Brazil, which was already inhabited by various Indigenous communities, is often credited to Portuguese navigator Pedro Álvares Cabral, who sighted the land later named Island of Vera Cruz, near Monte Pascoal, on 22 April 1500 while leading an expedition to India. Cabral's voyage is part of the so-called Portuguese discoveries.

zh.s: 人们通常认为，最早登陆今天巴西境内的欧洲探险者是葡萄牙航海家佩德罗·阿尔瓦雷斯·卡布拉尔。当时这片土地已有多个原住民社群居住。1500年4月22日，卡布拉尔率领船队前往印度途中，在蒙特帕斯夸尔附近看见了这片后来被称为维拉克鲁斯岛的土地。卡布拉尔的航行属于所谓的葡萄牙大发现时代。

en.s: Henry VIII (28 June 1491 – 28 January 1547) was King of England and Ireland from 22 April 1509 until his death in 1547. Henry was born in Greenwich as the second son of Henry VII and Elizabeth of York. His elder brother, Arthur, Prince of Wales, was heir apparent and married Catherine of Aragon, a Spanish princess.

zh.s: 亨利八世（1491年6月28日—1547年1月28日）自1509年4月22日起担任英格兰和爱尔兰国王，直至去世。他出生于格林尼治，是亨利七世和约克的伊丽莎白的次子。其兄长威尔士亲王亚瑟是王位继承人，并曾与西班牙公主阿拉贡的凯瑟琳结婚。

en.s: The Treaty of Zaragoza or Saragossa, also called the Capitulation of Zaragoza or Saragossa, was a peace treaty between Castile and Portugal, signed on 22 April 1529 by King John III of Portugal and the Habsburg Emperor Charles V in the Aragonese city of Zaragoza.

zh.s: 萨拉戈萨条约又称《萨拉戈萨和约》，是卡斯蒂利亚与葡萄牙之间的和平条约。1529年4月22日，葡萄牙国王若昂三世和哈布斯堡皇帝查理五世在阿拉贡城市萨拉戈萨签署该条约。

en.s: The naval Battle of Augusta (also known as the Battle of Agosta) took place on 22 April 1676 during the Franco-Dutch War and was fought between a French fleet of 29 man-of-war, five frigates and eight fireships under Abraham Duquesne and a Dutch-Spanish fleet of 27 (17 Dutch, 10 Spanish) plus five fireships with Dutch Lieutenant-Admiral-General Michiel de Ruyter in command. The battle was a short but intense affair and ended abruptly when Duquesne, after hearing that De Ruyter had been mortally wounded, retreated. Neither side lost a ship, though there were many dead and wounded, especially among the Dutch.

zh.s: 奥古斯塔海战又称阿戈斯塔海战，于1676年4月22日在法荷战争期间爆发。亚伯拉罕·迪凯纳指挥的法国舰队有29艘战舰、5艘护卫舰和8艘火船；荷兰海军中将米希尔·德·鲁伊特指挥的荷西联合舰队有27艘战舰（荷兰17艘、西班牙10艘）和5艘火船。战斗短促而激烈。迪凯纳听说德·鲁伊特身受致命伤后突然撤退。双方都没有舰船损失，但死伤不少，荷兰方面尤为严重。

en.s: The sieges of Ceuta, also known as the thirty-year siege, were a series of blockades by Moroccan forces of the Spanish-held city of Ceuta on the North African coast. The first siege began on 23 October 1694 and finished in 1720 when reinforcements arrived. During the 26 years of the first siege, the city underwent changes leading to the loss of its Portuguese character.

zh.s: 1727年4月22日，西班牙控制的休达派出侦察队，确认摩洛哥军队已撤离，长期围城就此结束。这是一系列针对北非海岸西班牙属休达城的摩洛哥封锁战，首轮围城自1694年10月23日开始，至1720年援军抵达才告终。长达26年的首轮围城期间，城市逐渐失去原有的葡萄牙特色。

en.s: The Vilnius Uprising of 1794 (Lithuanian: Vilniaus sukilimas) began on April 22, 1794, during which Polish-Lithuanian force led by Jakub Jasiński fought Russian forces occupying the city during the Kościuszko Uprising. The Russians were expelled from Vilnius, and thanks to Jasiński's skill, no casualties were sustained during the bloodless uprising. Vilnius townspeople also actively participated in the city's defense from the Russians, some even by throwing stones at them.

zh.s: 1794年维尔纽斯起义于4月22日爆发，是科希丘什科起义的一部分。雅库布·雅辛斯基率领的波兰—立陶宛部队与占领该城的俄军作战。俄军被逐出维尔纽斯。雅辛斯基指挥得当，起义没有造成人员伤亡；维尔纽斯居民也积极参与防守，有些人甚至向俄军投掷石块。

en.s: The Battle of Colonia del Sacramento took place in the night of 21/22 April 1807, during the British invasions of the River Plate. A force of 1,500 militias led by Colonel Francisco Javier de Eíío was repelled by 1,000 British infantry and cavalry troops holding the fortress of Colonia del Sacramento and commanded by Colonel Dennis Pack.

zh.t: 科洛尼亚德尔萨克拉门托战役（1807年）
zh.s: 拉普拉塔河入侵期间，英国军队于1807年4月21日至22日夜间进攻科洛尼亚德尔萨克拉门托。一支由弗朗西斯科·哈维尔·德·埃伊奥上校率领的1500人民兵部队被击退。守城的英国步兵和骑兵共1000人，由丹尼斯·帕克上校指挥。

en.t: The second day of the Battle of Eckmühl: The Austrian army is defeated by the First French Empire army led by Napoleon and driven over the Danube in Regensburg
en.s: The Battle of Eckmühl fought on 21–22 April 1809, was the turning point of the 1809 Campaign, also known as the War of the Fifth Coalition. Napoleon I had been unprepared for the start of hostilities on 10 April 1809, by the Austrians under Archduke Charles of Austria, and for the first time since assuming the French Imperial Crown had been forced to give up the strategic initiative to an opponent.

zh.t: 埃克米尔战役第二天：奥地利军队被拿破仑率领的法兰西第一帝国军队击败，并被赶过雷根斯堡的多瑙河
zh.s: 埃克米尔战役发生于1809年4月21日至22日，是1809年战役（又称第五次反法同盟战争）的转折点。1809年4月10日，奥地利军队在奥地利的卡尔大公率领下发动进攻，拿破仑一世对此毫无准备。自登上法国皇帝之位以来，他第一次被迫将战略主动权交给对手。

en.s: The siege of Astorga was an attempt by French forces to capture Astorga, Spain in a campaign of the Peninsular War. Astorga was located on the flank of the French invasion of Spain and Portugal, and was meant to be used as a headquarters during the campaign. For several weeks no attack took place, as neither side had artillery enough to fight well. Shortly after the French guns arrived, however, a hole was made in the wall and the city fell shortly thereafter. The French overpowered the Spanish garrison inside and took the city on 22 April 1810.

zh.s: 半岛战争期间，法国军队试图攻占西班牙阿斯托加。该城位于法国入侵西班牙和葡萄牙的侧翼，法军原计划将其用作战役总部。数周内双方都没有发动进攻，因为彼此都缺少足够的火炮。法国火炮抵达后不久，城墙被轰开缺口，阿斯托加很快失守。法军击败城内西班牙守军，于1810年4月22日占领该城。

en.s: The Battle of Grahamstown took place on 22 April 1819, during the Fifth Xhosa War (1818-1819), at the frontier settlement of Grahamstown in what is now the Eastern Cape province of South Africa. The confrontation involved the defence of the town by the British garrison, aided by a group of Khoekhoe marksmen, from an attack by a large force of attacking Xhosa warriors.

zh.s: 格雷厄姆斯敦战役于1819年4月22日在第五次科萨战争期间打响，地点是当时的边境聚居点格雷厄姆斯敦，位于今天南非东开普省。英国驻军在一群科伊科伊人神枪手的协助下，抵御了大批科萨战士的进攻。

en.s: The Battle of San Roque was part of the Argentine Civil War. It was fought on the Primero River, near the city of Córdoba, Argentina, on 22 April 1829. The Federalist forces of Córdoba Province governor Juan Bautista Bustos were defeated by the Unitarian forces of General José María Paz. As a result of his victory, Paz assumed the office of provincial Governor.

zh.s: 圣罗克战役是阿根廷内战的一部分，于1829年4月22日在阿根廷科尔多瓦市附近的普里梅罗河畔进行。科尔多瓦省长胡安·包蒂斯塔·布斯托斯率领的联邦派部队被何塞·玛丽亚·帕斯将军率领的统一派部队击败。帕斯获胜后出任省长。

en.s: The Battle of Alsasua, also known as the Battle of Altsasu or la Acción de la Venta, was a battle that occurred on April 22, 1834 during the First Carlist War. Carlist general Tomás de Zumalacárregui destroyed a convoy led by the Liberal general Vicente Genaro de Quesada traveling from Vitoria-Gasteiz to Pamplona at the town of Alsasua. The Liberals suffered many casualties and Zumalacárregui took many prisoners. Zumalacárregui formed the unit known as Guías de Navarra from Liberal troops from La Mancha, Valencia, Andalusia and other places who had been made prisoners at this battle.

zh.s: 阿尔萨苏阿战役又称阿尔察苏战役或“拉本塔战斗”，于1834年4月22日第一次卡洛斯战争期间发生。卡洛斯派将领托马斯·德·苏马拉卡雷吉在阿尔萨苏阿镇击溃一支车队。车队由自由派将领比森特·赫纳罗·德·克萨达率领，正从维多利亚-加斯泰斯前往潘普洛纳。自由派伤亡惨重，苏马拉卡雷吉俘虏了多人。他还把在这场战斗中俘获的拉曼查、巴伦西亚、安达卢西亚等地自由派士兵编成纳瓦拉向导队。

en.s: The Battle of Artaza (Acción de Artaza) occurred on 20–22 April 1835 during the First Carlist War. Jerónimo Valdés, at the time Minister of War, arrived at the area known as Las Amescoas with 22,000 men with the intention of definitively destroying the Carlist forces. Zumalacárregui had 5,000 men, but had the advantage of knowing the terrain and practicing guerrilla tactics.

zh.s: 第一次卡洛斯战争期间，阿尔塔萨战役（西班牙语：Acción de Artaza）于1835年4月20日至22日进行。时任战争大臣的赫罗尼莫·巴尔德斯率领2.2万人来到拉斯阿梅斯科阿斯地区，准备彻底消灭卡洛斯派军队。苏马拉卡雷吉只有5000人，但他熟悉当地地形，并善于运用游击战术。

en.s: The Battle of Wad Kaltabu, also known as the Battle of Kalnabu, was a military engagement fought on 22 April 1837 between the forces of Kenfu Haile Giorgis, a nobleman of Dembiya, and an Ottoman-Egyptian force led by Ahmad Kashif. Due to the similarities between the Battle of Gallabat (1837) (the first battle at Gallabat), and Wadkaltabu which would occur a month later, the two events are often conflated and details mixed up.

zh.s: 瓦德卡尔塔布战役又称卡尔纳布战役，于1837年4月22日发生，交战双方是登比亚贵族肯富·海尔·乔治斯的部队和艾哈迈德·卡希夫率领的奥斯曼—埃及军队。1837年加拉巴特战役（第一次加拉巴特战役）与一个月后发生的瓦德卡尔塔布战役有相似之处，因此两场战斗常被混为一谈，相关细节也经常混淆。

en.s: The Battle of Las Carreras (Spanish: Batalla de Las Carreras) was a major battle during the years after the Dominican War of Independence and was fought on the 21–22 April 1849, nearby Baní, Peravia Province. A force of 800 Dominican troops, a portion of the Army of the South, led by General Pedro Santana, defeated an outnumbering force of 10,000 troops of the Haitian Army led by Faustin Soulouque.

en.s: The 1874 Victorian colonial election was held from 25 March to 22 April 1874 to elect the 8th Parliament of Victoria. All 78 seats in 49 electorates in the Legislative Assembly were up for election, though eleven seats were uncontested. There were 24 single-member, 21 two-member and 4 three-member electorates. The Premier James Francis fought the 1874 general election on a proposition for constitutional reform to settle disputes between the Legislative Assembly and the Legislative Council by joint sittings.

en.s: The Battle at the Ržanica Bridge (Albanian: Beteja te Ura e Rzhanicës; Serbian: Bitka kod Ržanice/Битка код Ржанице) was a significant battle between Albanian tribesmen and Montenegrin forces during the Battles for Plav and Gusinje. The battle played a crucial role in preventing the annexation of the tribal lands of Gruda and Hoti by Montenegro.

en.s: The 1884 Louisiana gubernatorial election was the second election to take place under the Louisiana Constitution of 1879. Incumbent governor Samuel D. McEnery had been elected Lieutenant Governor in 1879, succeeding Gov. Louis A. Wiltz upon the latter's death in 1881. With assistance from the New Orleans "Ring," McEnery defeated a challenge for nomination from White League chieftain, Frederick Nash Ogden.

zh.s: 1884年路易斯安那州州长选举是该州1879年宪法通过后的第二次选举。时任州长塞缪尔·D·麦肯纳里于1879年当选副州长，并在州长路易·A·威尔茨于1881年去世后接任州长。在新奥尔良“圈子”的支持下，麦肯纳里击败了白人联盟首领弗雷德里克·纳什·奥格登提出的党内提名挑战。

en.s: The 1889 Welsh Cup final, the 12th in the competition, was contested by Bangor and Northwich Victoria at the Racecourse Ground. Bangor, in their first Welsh Cup final, won 2–1 in a match that would mark the first time these two teams, future founders and rivals of the Northern Premier League and Alliance Premier League would meet in a major final.

en.t: Accrington F.C. 0–1 Sheffield United F.C. (1893 Football League Test Match)
en.s: The 1892–93 season Test Matches were played on 22 April 1893. Accrington of Division One played Sheffield United of Division Two in a game at Trent Bridge, Nottingham which United won 1–0. A goal from United's Scottish forward John Drummond was enough to clinch victory for the Yorkshire side and saw them promoted to play in the First Division for the following season, with Accrington taking their place in the second.

zh.s: 1892—93赛季的升级测试赛于1893年4月22日举行。甲级联赛的阿克灵顿队在诺丁汉特伦特桥球场迎战乙级联赛的谢菲尔德联队，最终以0比1告负。谢菲尔德联的苏格兰前锋约翰·德拉蒙德攻入全场唯一进球，帮助球队升入下赛季甲级联赛，阿克灵顿则降入乙级。

en.s: The battle of Kousséri was a major engagement fought between France and the forces of the warlord Rabih az-Zubayr in the Rabih War. The conflict originated in French plans to occupy the Chari-Baguirmi region in modern-day Chad. In 1899–1900, the French organized three armed columns, one proceeding north from Congo, one east from Niger and another south from Algeria.

'Mesolympics'), held from 22 April 1906 to 2 May 1906, was an international multi-sport event that was celebrated in Athens, Greece. en.s: The London Naval Treaty, officially the Treaty for the Limitation and Reduction of Naval Armament, was an agreement between the United Kingdom, Japan, France, Italy, and the United States that was signed on 22 April 1930. Seeking to address issues not covered in the 1922 Washington Naval Treaty, which had created tonnage limits for each nation's surface warships, the new agreement regulated submarine warfare, further controlled cruisers and destroyers, and limited naval shipbuilding.

zh.s: 《伦敦海军条约》全称《限制和削减海军军备条约》，由英国、日本、法国、意大利和美国签订，于1930年4月22日签署。1922年《华盛顿海军条约》规定了各国水面军舰吨位上限，但未涵盖所有问题；新条约则规范潜艇战、进一步限制巡洋舰和驱逐舰，并限制海军造船。

American and Allied forces undertook an amphibious landing on 22 April 1944 at Aitape on the northern coast of Papua New Guinea. The amphibious landing was undertaken simultaneously with the landings at Humboldt and Tanahmerah Bays to secure Hollandia to isolate the Japanese 18th Army at Wewak.

en.s: Sachsenhausen (German pronunciation: [zaksn̩ˈhaʊzn̩] ) or Sachsenhausen-Oranienburg was a Nazi concentration camp in Oranienburg, Germany, used from 1936 until April 1945, shortly before the defeat of Nazi Germany in May. It mainly held political prisoners throughout World War II.

zh.s: 1945年4月22日，苏联红军与波兰军队进入纳粹德国萨克森豪森集中营，解放留在营内的约三千四百名囚犯。该营位于德国奥拉宁堡，也称萨克森豪森－奥拉宁堡集中营，自1936年使用至1945年4月、纳粹德国战败前夕；二战期间主要关押政治犯。

en.t: Civil War in Mandatory Palestine: The Jewish paramilitary group Haganah captured Haifa from the Arab Liberation Army
en.s: The Battle of Haifa, also known as the Fall of Haifa, and called by the Jewish forces Operation Bi'ur Hametz (Hebrew: מבצע ביעור חמץ "Cleansing the Leaven" or "Passover Cleaning"), was a Haganah operation carried out on 21–22 April 1948 and a major event in the final stages of the civil war in Palestine, leading up to the 1948 Arab–Israeli War.

en.s: Operation Dauntless was a military operation performed by the United Nations Command (UN) during the Korean War designed to advance the UN lines to positions 10–20 miles (16–32 km) north of the 38th Parallel designated the Wyoming Line which would threaten the Chinese and North Korean logistics hub marked out by the towns of Pyonggang, Ch'orwon and Gimhwa-eup named the Iron Triangle. The operation immediately succeeded Operation Rugged which took the UN forces to the Kansas Line 2 to 6 miles (3.2 to 9.7 km) north of the 38th Parallel. The operation was initially successful, reaching its initial objectives, but was brought to a halt by the Chinese Spring Offensive on 22 April 1951.

zh.s: 朝鲜战争期间，联合国军实施无畏行动，计划将战线推进到北纬38度线以北10至20英里（16至32公里）的“怀俄明线”，威胁平康、铁原和金化邑等地组成的铁三角后勤枢纽。此前的“粗犷行动”已将联合国军推进到北纬38度线以北2至6英里（3.2至9.7公里）的“堪萨斯线”。无畏行动起初进展顺利，达到最初目标，但于1951年4月22日因中国人民志愿军春季攻势而停止。

en.s: The 1964 Saskatchewan general election was held on April 22, 1964, to elect members of the 15th Saskatchewan Legislature. The Co-operative Commonwealth Federation (CCF) government of Premier Woodrow Lloyd was defeated by the Liberal Party, led by Ross Thatcher. The CCF had governed Saskatchewan since the 1944 election under the leadership (until December 1961) of Tommy Douglas. en.s: The Sunday Times Golden Globe Race was a non-stop, single-handed, round-the-world yacht race, held in 1968–1969, and was the first non-stop round-the-world yacht race. The race was controversial due to the failure of eight of nine competitors to finish the race and because of the apparent suicide of one entrant, Donald Crowhurst; however, it ultimately led to the founding of the BOC Challenge and Vendée Globe round-the-world races, both of which continue to be successful and popular.
en.n: British yachtsman Sir Robin Knox-Johnston wins the Sunday Times Golden Globe Race and completes the first solo non-stop circumnavigation of the world.

zh.s: 《星期日泰晤士报》金球奖环球帆船赛于1968至1969年举行，是首场不间断单人环球帆船赛。这项比赛因九名参赛者中有八人未能完赛，以及参赛者唐纳德·克劳赫斯特疑似自杀而引发争议。比赛最终促成了后来的BOC挑战赛和旺代环球帆船赛，这两项环球帆船赛事至今仍很受欢迎，也持续举办。
zh.n: 英国帆船运动员罗宾·诺克斯-约翰斯顿爵士赢得《星期日泰晤士报》金球奖环球帆船赛，完成首次单人不间断环球航行。

en.s: General elections were held in South Africa on 22 April 1970 to elect members of the 166-seat House of Assembly. Parliament was dissolved on 2 March and the deadline for the submission of candidates was 13 March. The elections marked the first time since the formation of South African in 1910 that the House of Assembly would be responsible solely to White South Africans, as the seats for the four MPs elected separately by "qualified" Cape Coloured voters expired in the same year, completing the process of political apartheid.

zh.s: 南非于1970年4月22日举行大选，选出166名众议院议员。议会于3月2日解散，候选人提名截止日期为3月13日。这是1910年南非成立以来，众议院首次只向白人选民负责。此前由“合资格”开普有色人种选民单独选出的四名议员，其席位恰于当年届满，完成了政治种族隔离的进程。

en.s: The 1972 Tasmanian state election was held on 22 April 1972 in the Australian state of Tasmania to elect 35 members of the Tasmanian House of Assembly. The election used the Hare-Clark proportional representation system — seven members were elected from each of five electorates. The one-term Liberal government of Premier Angus Bethune had collapsed following the withdrawal of support by Kevin Lyons.

zh.s: 澳大利亚塔斯马尼亚州于1972年4月22日举行州选举，选出州众议院的35名议员。选举采用哈里—克拉克比例代表制，每个选区选出7名议员，共有5个选区。自由党省长安格斯·贝休恩领导的一届政府因凯文·莱昂斯撤回支持而倒台。

en.s: Pan Am Flight 812, operated by a Pan Am Boeing 707 registered N446PA and named Clipper Climax, was a scheduled international flight from Hong Kong to Los Angeles, California, with intermediate stops at Denpasar, Sydney, Nadi, and Honolulu. On April 22, 1974, the aircraft crashed into rough mountainous terrain while preparing for a runway 09 approach to Denpasar after a 4-hour 20-minute flight from Hong Kong.

en.s: The 1975 Honduran coup d'état took place on 22 April 1975, with Oswaldo López Arellano being ousted in a military coup led by his fellow General Juan Alberto Melgar Castro. The coup was prompted in part by the "Bananagate" scandal, exposed by the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission in 1975, in which the United Brands Company agreed to bribe President López with US$1.25 million, and the promise of another $1.25 million upon the reduction of certain banana export taxes.

zh.s: 1975年4月22日，洪都拉斯发生军事政变。胡安·阿尔贝托·梅尔加·卡斯特罗将军率领政变，推翻了同为将军的奥斯瓦尔多·洛佩斯·阿雷利亚诺。政变的原因之一是“香蕉门”丑闻：美国证券交易委员会于1975年揭露，联合品牌公司同意向洛佩斯总统行贿125万美元，并承诺在某些香蕉出口税下调后再支付125万美元。

en.s: The Battle of Jinja was a battle of the Uganda–Tanzania War that took place on 22 April 1979 near and in the city of Jinja, Uganda between Tanzanian and allied Uganda National Liberation Front forces on the one hand, and Ugandan troops loyal to Idi Amin on the other. The Tanzanians and the UNLF men met slight resistance and captured Owen Falls Dam and the town of Jinja.

zh.s: 乌干达—坦桑尼亚战争期间，坦桑尼亚军队及其盟友乌干达民族解放阵线部队于1979年4月22日在乌干达金贾市及周边与效忠伊迪·阿明的乌干达军队交战。坦桑尼亚和解放阵线部队只遇到轻微抵抗，便占领了欧文瀑布大坝和金贾镇。

en.s: The 1989 WFA Cup Final was the 19th final of the WFA Cup, England's primary cup competition for women's football teams. Friends of Fulham and Leasowe Pacific contested the match at Old Trafford in Manchester on 22 April 1989.

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in North Korea on 22 April 1990. 687 deputies were elected to the ninth Supreme People's Assembly. First session was on May 24–26, 1990. Of the 689 deputies, workers accounted for 37 percent, farmers 10.4 percent, and women 20.1 percent (138 seats). The Korean Social Democratic Party held 7.4 percent and the Chondoist Chongu Party held 3.2 percent of the seats, the two parties together holding 10.6 percent of the seats.

Rebel troops seized the FRCN radio station and various military posts around Lagos, including the military headquarters and presidential residence, the Dodan Barracks.

en.s: A series of ten explosions took place on April 22, 1992, in the downtown district of Analco Colonia Atlas in Guadalajara city, Jalisco state, Mexico. Numerous gasoline explosions in the sewer system and fires over four hours destroyed 8 kilometres (5.0 mi) of streets. Gante Street was the most damaged. By the accounting of Lloyd's of London, the reported number of people killed was about 252, although many estimate that the catastrophe actually caused at least 1,000 deaths.

zh.s: 1992年4月22日，墨西哥哈利斯科州瓜达拉哈拉市中心的阿纳尔科—阿特拉斯街区连续发生10起爆炸。下水道中多次发生汽油爆炸并引发火灾，四个多小时里摧毁了8公里（5英里）长的街道，其中甘特街受损最严重。伦敦劳合社统计的死亡人数约为252人，但许多人估计灾难实际造成至少1000人死亡。

en.t: Eighteen-year-old Stephen Lawrence is murdered in a racially motivated attack while waiting for a bus in Well Hall, Eltham
en.s: Stephen Adrian Lawrence (13 September 1974 – 22 April 1993) was an 18-year-old black British student from Woolwich, southeast London, England who was murdered in a racially motivated attack while waiting for a bus on Well Hall Road in Eltham, on the evening of 22 April 1993. The case became a cause célèbre; its fallout included changes of attitudes on racism and the police, and to the law and police practice.

zh.t: 18岁的斯蒂芬·劳伦斯在埃尔瑟姆候车时遭种族主义袭击身亡
zh.s: 斯蒂芬·阿德里安·劳伦斯（1974年9月13日—1993年4月22日）是一名18岁的英国黑人学生，来自英格兰伦敦东南部伍尔维奇。他于1993年4月22日晚在埃尔瑟姆韦尔霍尔路等车时遭到种族主义袭击并被杀害。此案引发广泛关注，推动社会对种族主义、警察执法及相关法律和警务实践的态度发生变化。

en.s: Operation Chavín de Huántar was a military operation in which a team of one hundred and forty-two commandos of the Peruvian Armed Forces ended the 1997 Japanese embassy hostage crisis by raiding the Japanese ambassador's residence and freeing the hostages held there by the Túpac Amaru Revolutionary Movement (MRTA) being considered one of the most successful hostage rescues in the world. zh.s: 查文德万塔尔行动中，秘鲁武装部队派出142名突击队员突袭日本大使官邸，结束了1997年日本大使馆人质危机，并救出被图帕克·阿马鲁革命运动扣押的人质。这次行动被认为是世界上最成功的人质营救行动之一。为实施突袭，行动人员需要从相邻建筑向大使官邸下方挖掘隧道，因此行动以查文德万塔尔遗址命名。

en.s: During the Sri Lankan Civil War, the Muhamalai Forward Defence Line was the Army Defence Line separating the Sri Lankan Army and Liberation Tigers of Tamil Eelam (LTTE) militia in North Central Kilinochchi from South Central Jaffna. The distance between the first line of defences ranged from 200 to 600 meters. Sri Lankan soldiers captured the 1st Forward Defence Line (FDL) between Muhamalai and Kilali at around 05:00 on 20 November 2008, pushing the LTTE lines 800m southward.

zh.s: 斯里兰卡内战期间，穆哈马莱前沿防线是斯里兰卡军队与泰米尔伊拉姆猛虎解放组织（LTTE）民兵之间的军队防线，分隔北中部基利诺奇和南中部贾夫纳。前沿防线之间的距离为200至600米。2008年11月20日约05:00，斯里兰卡士兵攻占穆哈马莱与基拉利之间的第一道前沿防线（FDL），将LTTE防线向南推进800米。

en.s: South Africa held national and provincial elections to elect a new National Assembly as well as the provincial legislature in each province on 22 April 2009. The National Assembly consists of 400 members elected by proportional representation with a closed list approach. Two hundred members are elected from national party lists; the other 200 are elected from provincial party lists in each of the nine provinces. The President of South Africa is chosen by the National Assembly after each election; in 2009, the presidential election was on 6 May. The premiers of each province are chosen by the winning majority in each provincial legislature.

zh.s: 南非于2009年4月22日举行全国和省级选举，选出新一届国民议会及各省议会。国民议会有400个席位，采用封闭名单比例代表制：200席按全国政党名单分配，另200席按九个省的政党名单分配。每次选举后由国民议会选出南非总统；2009年的总统选举于5月6日举行。各省省长由该省议会中的多数党选出。

en.s: The 2012 A-League Grand Final was the seventh A-League Grand Final, which took place on 22 April 2012 at Suncorp Stadium in Brisbane for the second year running. Brisbane Roar played in their second Grand Final in two years, and were aiming to become the first A-League team to win back-to-back Championships. Perth Glory played in their first Grand Final since the 2004 NSL Grand Final, and their first A-League Grand Final. Additionally, it was the first Grand Final since 2006 that did not include the Premiers.

en.s: A presidential election was held in France on 22 April 2012 (or 21 April in some overseas departments and territories), with a second round run-off held on 6 May (or 5 May for those same territories) to elect the President of France (who is also ex officio one of the two joint heads of state of Andorra, a sovereign state). The incumbent Nicolas Sarkozy was running for a second successive and, under the terms of the constitution, final term in the election. The first round ended with the selection of François Hollande and Nicolas Sarkozy as second round participants, as neither of them received a majority of votes cast in the first round.

en.s: The Paris Agreement (also called the Paris Accords or Paris Climate Accords) is an international treaty on climate change that was signed in 2016. The treaty covers climate change mitigation, adaptation, and finance. The Paris Agreement was negotiated by 196 parties at the 2015 United Nations Climate Change Conference near Paris, France. en.s: On 22 April 2020, a truck driver under the influence of drugs, Mohinder Singh, crashed his truck into a private vehicle and two police cars on the Eastern Freeway in the suburb of Kew East, Australia, killing four police officers who were on routine highway patrol. Prior to the incident, the officers had pulled over driver Richard Pusey for speeding in his Porsche. After the truck hit the officers, Pusey filmed them for several minutes with vulgar commentary as they lay dying, before fleeing. en.s: The 2024 Basilicata regional election was held on 21 and 22 April 2024 for all 21 elected seats of the Regional Council of Basilicata and the president of Basilicata, who automatically becomes a member of the council alongside the second-placed candidate. en.t: 2025 Connecticut House of Representatives District 113 special election
en.s: A special election in the U.S. state of Connecticut was held on April 22, 2025, to elect a new member to the Connecticut House of Representatives to represent District 113. The special election was called after the resignation of longtime Republican incumbent Jason Perillo following his election to the Connecticut Senate. District 113 contains part of the town of Shelton, located within the Naugatuck Valley Planning Region.

en.s: The 2025 Pahalgam attack, also referred to as the 2025 Pahalgam massacre, was an Islamist terrorist attack on tourists by three armed militants near Pahalgam in Indian-administered Jammu and Kashmir in which 26 civilians were killed on 22 April 2025. The attackers targeted Hindu tourists, though a Christian tourist and a local Muslim pony ride operator were also killed.

en.t: 2025 Mississippi House of Representatives special election
en.s: The 2025 Mississippi House of Representatives special election was held on November 4, 2025, to elect 5 of 122 members of the Mississippi House of Representatives. Special elections were called in 5 districts due to court-ordered redistricting, in addition to special elections held on April 22 to fill vacancies in two districts. Primary elections were held on August 5, and runoff elections were canceled as all elections resulted in majority wins.

zh.t: 2025年密西西比州众议院特别选举
zh.s: 2025年密西西比州众议院特别选举于2025年11月4日举行，选出众议院122名议员中的5名。因法院命令重新划分选区，5个选区举行特别选举；此外，4月22日还在两个选区举行了填补议席空缺的特别选举。初选于8月5日举行。所有选举都由候选人以多数票胜出，因此取消了第二轮选举。
